audience: teams that produce invoices, contracts or proposals as PDFs from templates in Documint

useCases.title: List templates to find an id
useCases.text: List your document templates with their ids, names and created dates. Use the id to merge data into a template.

useCases.title: Read the details of one template
useCases.text: Get one template by id to check its details before you merge data into it.

useCases.title: Create a PDF from a template for a client
useCases.text: Merge the field values of a client into a template. Each call creates a new document in your account and returns the hosted PDF link.
